description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - An Industrial Disputes between K. P. Pemasiri and B. A. Darmasena vs. Royal Colombo Golf Club
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains an order made by the Minister under Section 4(1) of the Act to appoint an arbitrator to settle an industrial dispute between specific individuals and the Royal Colombo Golf Club. The content focuses on legal procedures, statutory powers, and dispute resolution mechanisms rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
